suggestions.rationale: Mapping Expansion Batch ME-1 adds this relationship only as a bounded clinical proposition. Require documented pulmonary tuberculosis preceding separately documented bronchiectasis, with imaging and clinical context consistent with post-tuberculosis structural lung disease. Do not infer bronchiectasis from tuberculosis history alone, and do not generalize this pulmonary-sequela pathway to isolated extrapulmonary tuberculosis. The cited literature supports only this constrained relationship and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
